summary: Test all present elements in ascending order using JavaScript truthiness, with vacuous truth for no visited elements.

target.notes: Snapshot length, skip holes, invoke each callback through JsFunction.Call, apply JsValue.IsTruthy, and return false immediately on the first falsy result; otherwise return true.

semantics.callback_callable_check: TypeError before iteration if callback is not callable

caveats: An all-hole array returns true without invoking the callback.
A direct Enumerable.All assumes a dense CLR sequence and Boolean predicate.

tests.name: short-circuits on first falsy result
tests.input: const seen=[]; const r=[1,2,3].every((v)=>{seen.push(v); return v<2}); console.log(r,seen.join(','));

tests.name: truthiness is not C# bool conversion
